snippet.title: What’s Hiding in TESERA’s Mines? | Official Teaser
snippet.description:
What’s Hiding in TESERA’s Mines?

Procedurally generated abandoned mines have arrived in TESERA.
Collapsed corridors. Signs of… something recent.
Not just a new zone — a new system.

🔧 The update is live!
